messages:
sarah: kicking off blue->green for router v5 in eu-west1. plan: 3m shadow, 5% warm, step to 25% at +10m, evaluate, then 60% at +20m. session-pin cookie keeps web-admin on old fleet. hold other infra changes.
devops: noted, quiet window set 02:00-04:00 UTC. I'll watch auth flows.
marco: quick check: did we include L7 header pin for /admin and /metrics? want zero churn there.
sarah: added L7 rule: `lbctl rule create --path /admin,/metrics --action backend=v5-stable --header X-Session=pin-old` <- this pins to old until we flip header.
deploy-bot: [deploy] start d-171888-99 router:v5 -> eu-west1. shadowing traffic -> OK.
anita: initial telemetry: p50 fine, small p95 regressions for embed-lookup. set trace-sample=0.2 for v5 to get stacks.
marco: infra-bot can you confirm pool warm counts for embedder? we want min_ready=6.
infra-bot: min_ready for pool embedder-eu set to 6 (was 3). Warmer nodes spinning up.
devops: applying 5% weight now. weights: v4=95 v5=5.
deploy-bot: weights changed -> v4:95 v5:5. Canary timer started (10m).
anita: seeing path-specific 503s on long-context requests hitting v5. logs show: "connection reset by peer" to embedder.
marco: maybe kernel mismatch on v5 quantized runtime. try lowering batch size and using pooled connections.
sarah: adjusting runtime flags for v5: `--max-batch=4 --conn-pool=shared`
infra-bot: applied conn-pool change to v5 backends.
anita: after change 503s reduced but p95 still +80ms on long contexts. variance higher than acceptable.
devops: let's pause the ramp at 5% and open a short investigation window. Moving to manual approval to continue.
sarah: agreed. pausing automated ramps. I'll notify product and docs.
marco: suggestion: route only short-context prompts to v5 for next attempt. We can match by header X-Req-Length=short.
sarah: creating header rule: `lbctl route add --match header:X-Req-Length=short --backend v5` to keep long prompts on v4.
anita: after routing rule p95 delta narrows to +10ms on matched traffic. Good signal. Recommend proceed with route-limited ramp to 25%.
devops: proceed to 25% on short-context traffic. weights within that cohort: v4=75 v5=25.
deploy-bot: cohort weights updated.
anita: monitors green. no new 5xx, tail latency stable.
marco: because of prior churn, let's hold overall cutover until embedder kernel tuning is done; proceed only within short-context cohort. We'll file INF-4999 for kernel pin.
sarah: capturing follow-ups and updating release notes. next attempt will include quant-kernel v5.1 and connection pooling tweaks.
deploy-bot: marking deployment d-171888-99 as paused (manual continue).
devops: if any regression detected escalate to rollback. rollback play: `deployctl rollback d-171888-99 --region eu-west1 --to v4` prepared.
anita: thanks everyone. scheduling a 1hr follow-up after kernel patch. closing for now. :white_check_mark:
